# Runner image workspaces

- Follow `docs/ui/runner-image-workspaces.md` and the matching Impeccable surface brief.
- Consume only shipped typed capabilities from the owning implementation issues; a UX
  contract never authorizes placeholder mutations or broader backend scope.
- Keep readiness, attention-ordered records, one deep-linked detail, and complete
  confirmation evidence together. Preserve excluded, stale, unavailable, and
  indeterminate state without substitution or success-shaped fallbacks.
- Never introduce label-only authorization, arbitrary workflow/registry/command/path
  input, automatic target widening, automatic rollback, raw logs, or job cancellation.
